S.FORM: alang Larepaq ga niya mki sku Tayto Keng atu Taznin go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 126 buwan, 326 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 99% kyan ku 324 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 1% kyan ku 2 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Paywan 96%, Amis 1%, Truku 1%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. rhzyal kki'an tay 'zil na Larepaq hya' ga Tjuaqau. rekisi kayal kyokay maki 1 kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Larepaq ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ larepaq ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku tajto keŋ atu taznin ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa pajwan ** ami[s|ɕ] * truku * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔzil na larepaq ħjaʔ ɣa tjuaqau reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj maki * kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ larepaq ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
